headlines.text: That Friday in 2021, Junior Dos Santos wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.66.
2025 brought us this moment: Jurassic Express & Omega touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a strong outing.
2025 brought us this moment: Brodido & Briscoe didn't ease in ? their first AEW match was the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.64.

secondaries.text: On a Friday in 2021, back when CM Punk vs. Matt Sydal crossed paths for the first time ever, setting the tone as the night's opener on Rampage, rated 7.42 ? a match that delivered.
On a Wednesday in 2025, back when Garcia & Yuta made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.33.

Back on this day in 2025, The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. LFI (Dralistico, Mortos & Rush) clashed for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.14. For LFI (Dralistico, Mortos & Rush), it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
